name: 地名と住所を二段で読む位置情報行
prompt: Create a compact Japanese Lighthouse location information row using corrected original source address-row for exact pin anatomy and Japanese preview for wording and hierarchy. White #FFFFFF surfaces. One modest location pin at left: original long teardrop outline with pointed bottom and SOLID circular dot centered inside round upper head; no hollow ring center, no map or generic diamond. Recolor original blue utility pin to coherent slate #526173, fine original proportions and stroke. Right two text lines, exact first '代々木の公園' Meiryo REGULAR14/24 dark #1D1D1D, second '東京都渋谷区代々木・日本' Meiryo Regular12/16 gray #6E6E6E. Zero tracking, no bold or semibold. Pin vertically centered against two-line text block; small consistent 16px gap. Bottom thin neutral divider #D9DEE3, same native inset horizontal span; no top divider necessary. Compact row width390/heightabout110 proportion with modest24px side margins, no oversized type and no poster-like blank expanse. No green because this is neutral information, no heading, cards, shadows, disclosure button or added text. All Japanese characters complete and readable. Static Japanese sample location, not current-address verification.
reviewNotes: Corrected source crop inspected and filled-dot pin restored in slate. Japanese two-line Regular body/metadata hierarchy and divider complete. Pin too large relative to text compared with original; target 75 percent glyph scale only, preserving dot and teardrop anatomy.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
